slides.title: The longest slide title a release has carried so far
slides.body: A body as long as the longest a release has shipped. Settings has a new page with a list of choices, a button that opens a folder picker and a line that says where the file went. It stays open across chats until you close it, and a warning or a channel's members open it when they need it, so the card has to hold all of this text.

slides.title: Fixes
slides.body: A slide with no screenshot. Sheets that open over the start-up screen take clicks again. Upgrading no longer loses a sign-in, which stopped the agent from starting after the last update. The agent stack is a new version.
